theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_creg_straightening
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (h : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ) (Ω : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (w₀ : Eucl (m + 1)), IsOpen Ω → w₀ ∈ Ω → ContDiff ℝ 1 h → fderiv ℝ h w₀ ≠ 0 → ∃ (B : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (χ : Eucl (m + 1) → Eucl (m + 1)), IsOpen B ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 χ B ∧ IsOpen (χ '' B) ∧ w₀ ∈ χ '' B ∧ χ '' B ⊆ Ω ∧ (∃ Λ : ℝ≥0, LipschitzOnWith Λ χ B) ∧ (∀ y ∈ B, h (χ y) = y 0) ∧ ∀ (t : ℝ) (v v' : Eucl m), (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons t (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ v)) ∈ B → (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons t (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ v')) ∈ B → ‖v - v'‖ ≤ ‖χ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons t (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ v))) - χ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons t (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ v')))‖
